UI_Prepackaged_CurrentUpdate: In use: %1, version %2. Version %3 is ready: select it and press Update.
UI_Prepackaged_CurrentGone: In use: %1, version %2. Its pack file is no longer found.
UI_Prepackaged_StatusDefaults: %1 %2 of the pack's key binds and mod options wait for you: press Defaults.
UI_Prepackaged_ClipboardHow: Copy the text of a pack file, then press Paste a pack.
UI_Prepackaged_AlreadyListed: This pack is already in the list.
UI_Prepackaged_NoPacks: No packs found. Subscribe to a pack on the Workshop, put a pack file in Zomboid/Lua/%1, or copy the text of a pack file and press Paste a pack.
UI_Prepackaged_NoPacksPaste: No packs found. Subscribe to a pack on the Workshop, or copy the text of a pack file and press Paste a pack.
UI_Prepackaged_SourceClipboard: Pasted, kept as a file once used
UI_Prepackaged_DetailNoCollections: The pack has a collection but no @collections section, so the subscription helper can only open the top collection, whose Subscribe to all leaves out the sub-collections. A pack's build can write @collections from the collection on Steam.
UI_Prepackaged_DetailSandboxFeature: The game has no %1 any more, so the sandbox screen has no Apply pack until Prepackaged is updated.
UI_Prepackaged_DetailSandboxUse: They belong to a world or a server, not to your game. Once you use this pack, the New Game sandbox screen has Apply pack and the preset %1. Server sets up a server with them.
UI_Prepackaged_DetailPresetWritten: The sandbox preset %1 holds them, as of version %2. Apply pack on the New Game sandbox screen sets them too.
UI_Prepackaged_DetailPresetKept: The sandbox preset %1 has changes of your own, so Prepackaged left it as it is. Apply pack on the New Game sandbox screen sets the pack's values.
UI_Prepackaged_DetailPresetWaiting: The sandbox preset %1 is written once every mod of the pack that can be used is loaded. Apply pack on the New Game sandbox screen works already.
UI_Prepackaged_DetailSandboxUnplaced: Sandbox settings the game as loaded now can't place (%1): their mod isn't enabled or can't be used, or a typo
UI_Prepackaged_DetailUnplaced: Key binds and mod options the game as loaded now can't place (%1): their mod isn't enabled, or a typo
UI_Prepackaged_UseNewer: A newer version of the pack in use: %1, while %2 is in use.
UI_Prepackaged_UseOlder: An older version of the pack in use: %1, while %2 is in use.
UI_Prepackaged_DetailErrors: Errors (%1): the pack can't be used until its author fixes them.
UI_Prepackaged_TickUnavailable: %1, can't be used: the game version doesn't fit or a mod it needs is missing
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewDowngrade: Go back to version %3 of %1, from version %2
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewMissingCount: %1 of the pack's %2 mods aren't installed, so your mod list will be incomplete.
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewSubscribe: Subscriptions shows which of the pack's collections you lack items from, and opens their Workshop pages.
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewOptional: Optional mods (%1): tick the ones you want
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewUpdateRemoved: The update disables these mods of the pack (%1)
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewRemovedWorlds: Removing mods from an existing world can lose their items or break the save. Back up your save first.
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewMajor: This is a major update: it may not work with existing worlds. Back up your saves first, or start a new world.
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewUnavailable: Can't be used, left out (%1): the game version doesn't fit or a mod they need is missing
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewRequired: Added before the mods that need them: %1.
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewConflicts: The pack's order goes against these mods' own load order rules (the pack's order is used)
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewOwnConflicts: Your own mods stay after the pack's mods, in your order, which goes against these mods' own load order rules
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewOrder: The load order changes to the pack's order.
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewOwnMods: Using a pack replaces your mod list. Add your own mods afterwards in the Mods screen: updates of this pack keep them.
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewNoChange: Your mod list already matches. Apply only remembers the pack.
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewMapOrder: The map order becomes the pack's: %1.
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewMapOrderCleared: Your map order is cleared, so the game orders the maps by the new mod list.
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewSandboxWorld: These belong to a world or a server, so Apply changes none of them, and worlds you have keep their own. On the New Game sandbox screen, Apply pack sets them and the preset %1 holds them. Server in the Prepackaged window sets up a server with them.
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewSandboxUnknown: Version %1 was used with an older Prepackaged, which didn't keep its sandbox settings, so what changed since can't be shown.
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewSandboxRemoved: %1: no longer set by the pack (was %2)
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewBackup: Your mod list in use now is backed up first, in its exact load order and with its map order. Restore in the Prepackaged window brings it back.
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewReload: The game reloads its mods after Apply.
UI_Prepackaged_PresetPrompt: Save this mod list as the preset:
UI_Prepackaged_PresetSaved: Saved as the Mods screen preset "%1". Mods screen presets keep the mods, not their load order.
UI_Prepackaged_PresetFailed: The preset couldn't be saved. Your presets file from before is copied in Zomboid/Lua/%1.
UI_Prepackaged_AskIncomplete: %1 of the pack's %2 mods can't be enabled: they aren't installed or can't be used.
UI_Prepackaged_AskApplyAnyway: Your mod list will be incomplete. Apply anyway?
UI_Prepackaged_AskReplace: Zomboid/Lua/%1 already holds another pack file.
UI_Prepackaged_AskReplaceVersions: It has version %1, the pasted pack has version %2. Replace it?
UI_Prepackaged_FailNewer: Zomboid/Lua/%1 was written by a newer Prepackaged, so nothing was changed. Update Prepackaged first.
UI_Prepackaged_FailBackup: Your mod list couldn't be backed up to Zomboid/Lua/%1, so nothing was changed.
UI_Prepackaged_FailPackFile: The pasted pack couldn't be saved in Zomboid/Lua/%1, so your mod list wasn't changed.
UI_Prepackaged_FailState: Zomboid/Lua/%1 couldn't be saved, so your mod list wasn't changed.
UI_Prepackaged_RestoreKept: Your mod lists, key binds, mod options and server presets from before each change, newest first: the first of each for good, and the newest %1 of the others.
UI_Prepackaged_NoBackups: No backups yet. Prepackaged backs up your mod list, key binds, mod options and server presets before it changes them.
UI_Prepackaged_RestorePack: After the restore, the pack in use is %1, version %2, as it was then.
UI_Prepackaged_RestorePackUnknown: After the restore, the pack in use is %1, as it was then.
UI_Prepackaged_RestoreNoPack: After the restore, no pack is in use, as it was then.
UI_Prepackaged_RestoreWithout: Prepackaged isn't in this list, so it won't be enabled after the restore. Enable it in the Mods screen to use it again.
UI_Prepackaged_RestoreBackup: Your mod list in use now is backed up first. The game reloads its mods when they change.
UI_Prepackaged_AskRestore: Restore this list of %1 mods, in its exact order?
UI_Prepackaged_AskRestoreBackup: Your mod list in use now is backed up first.
UI_Prepackaged_AskRestoreFiles: Put back these key binds and mod options?
UI_Prepackaged_AskRestoreFilesBackup: Your key binds and mod options now are backed up first.
UI_Prepackaged_FilesFirst: Your key binds and mod options before Prepackaged
UI_Prepackaged_FilesBeforePack: Key binds and mod options before the defaults of %1, version %2
UI_Prepackaged_FilesBeforeRestore: Key binds and mod options before restoring backup %1
UI_Prepackaged_FilesDetail: Backup %1, %2, key binds and mod options
UI_Prepackaged_FilesRestore: Your key binds and mod options now are backed up first. Then the game reloads its mods, so the options screen reads both files again.
UI_Prepackaged_FailFilesBackup: Your key binds and mod options couldn't be backed up to Zomboid/Lua/%1, so nothing was changed.
UI_Prepackaged_FailRestoreFile: Zomboid/Lua/%1 couldn't be written. Your key binds and mod options from just before are in backup %2: restore that one.
UI_Prepackaged_ServerBackupBeforePack: Server %1 before setting it up from %2, version %3
UI_Prepackaged_ServerBackupSandbox: Zomboid/Server/%1_SandboxVars.lua: %2 sandbox settings, of the game and of the mods that were loaded
UI_Prepackaged_ServerBackupRestore: Restore sets these values again, after backing up the preset as it is now. If the preset's mods aren't loaded, the game loads them for it, then your own list again.
UI_Prepackaged_FailServerBackup: The server preset couldn't be backed up to Zomboid/Lua/%1, so nothing was changed.
UI_Prepackaged_DefaultsSubtitle: The pack's suggested values. Nothing changes until you press Apply.
UI_Prepackaged_DefaultsIntro: Ticked rows change when you press Apply. The others keep your value, and Prepackaged asks about them again only when the pack changes them. A tick starts on where you have the game's default or a value Prepackaged set, for this pack or another; a value you keep by unticking is yours from then on. Your key binds and mod options are backed up first, and Restore in the Prepackaged window brings them back.
UI_Prepackaged_DefaultsFeatureKeys: The game has no %1 any more, so the pack's key binds wait until Prepackaged is updated.
UI_Prepackaged_DefaultsFeatureOptions: The game has no %1 any more, so the pack's mod options wait until Prepackaged is updated.
UI_Prepackaged_DefaultsClashes: Keys used by more than one action after these changes (%1)
UI_Prepackaged_DefaultsInvalid: Can't be used (%1): the pack's author can fix these
UI_Prepackaged_DefaultsWaiting: Waiting (%1): tried again each time the game starts
UI_Prepackaged_DefaultsServer: Set by the server (%1), so left as they are
UI_Prepackaged_DefaultsDecided: %1 you decided on before aren't shown: Show all entries lists them.
UI_Prepackaged_DefaultsRestart: Some mods read their options only when the game starts: if a change doesn't show, restart the game.
UI_Prepackaged_DefaultsDone: Changed %1 key binds and mod options. Restore puts back the ones from before.
UI_Prepackaged_FailDefaultsState: The changes are made, but Zomboid/Lua/%1 couldn't be saved, so Prepackaged doesn't remember your answers and may ask again.
UI_Prepackaged_FailDefaultsWrite: %1 of the changes didn't read back from the game's files, so Prepackaged will ask about them again. Your key binds and mod options from before are in backup %2.
UI_Prepackaged_SubsIntro: On the Workshop, a collection's Subscribe to all gets its own items, not those of its sub-collections. So here each of the pack's collections and sub-collections shows what you lack, and Open shows its page.
UI_Prepackaged_SubsNoSteam: Steam isn't running for the game, so Prepackaged can't check what you have, and the game loads Workshop mods only with Steam. Open puts a page's address on the clipboard.
UI_Prepackaged_SubsNoOverlay: The Steam overlay is off, so Open puts the page's address on the clipboard: paste it into your browser.
UI_Prepackaged_SubsUnlisted: Collection %1: the pack doesn't list its items
UI_Prepackaged_SubsItemError: %1: subscribed but not installed. Steam may still be getting it; if Refresh doesn't change that, Steam has a problem with it
UI_Prepackaged_SubsItemNoDetails: %1: not installed, and Steam has no details: it may have been removed or hidden
UI_Prepackaged_SubsItemNoAnswer: %1: not installed, and Steam didn't answer
UI_Prepackaged_SubsAfter: Steam downloads what you subscribe to, and Refresh shows how far it got. The game may not see newly downloaded mods until it restarts: when the downloads are done, restart the game, then use the pack.
UI_Prepackaged_SubsStatusNoSteam: Steam is off, so nothing can be checked.
UI_Prepackaged_SubsStatusAsking: Asking Steam about %1 items: %2 answered so far.
UI_Prepackaged_SubsStatusPartly: Steam didn't answer for %1 of %2 items, so they show only as installed or not. Refresh asks again.
UI_Prepackaged_SubsStatusDone: Steam answered for all %1 items. Refresh asks again.
UI_Prepackaged_SubsCopied: The address of %1 is on the clipboard: %2
UI_Prepackaged_SandboxApplied: %1, version %2: %3 sandbox settings changed on this screen, %4 already had the pack's value.
UI_Prepackaged_SandboxCheck: Check them, then press Next: nothing is saved until the world is made.
UI_Prepackaged_SandboxNoPack: No pack is in use: use one in the Prepackaged window first.
UI_Prepackaged_SandboxUpdate: Version %2 of %1 is ready, but version %3 is in use: update it in the Prepackaged window first.
UI_Prepackaged_SandboxFeature: The game has no %1 any more, so Apply pack can't work until Prepackaged is updated.
UI_Prepackaged_SandboxMissing: %1: no setting of that name is loaded: its mod isn't in this game's mod list or can't be used, or a typo
UI_Prepackaged_SandboxInvalid: %1: not a value this setting takes
UI_Prepackaged_SandboxHidden: %1: this screen has no control for it, so it can't go into the world
UI_Prepackaged_SandboxLost: %1: the game's files didn't give this value back
UI_Prepackaged_ServerHostHow: Set up a server makes or changes a server preset in Zomboid/Server with the pack's mods and sandbox settings, then opens the Host screen with it chosen. It lists every file it will change and asks first.
UI_Prepackaged_ServerHostFeature: The game has no %1 any more, so Set up a server waits until Prepackaged is updated. Copy server lines still works.
UI_Prepackaged_ServerReload: The pack's mods aren't all loaded now, so setting up a server reloads the game's mods twice: with the pack's, then with yours.
UI_Prepackaged_ServerMemory: Memory for the server: %1 MB, as the pack suggests.
UI_Prepackaged_ServerLinesHow: Copy server lines puts these lines on the clipboard and in Zomboid/Lua/%1. A new server writes its .ini and _SandboxVars.lua when it first starts. Then replace the WorkshopItems, Mods and Map lines in the .ini, add the rest to the end of the _SandboxVars.lua, and start the server again: it reads them and writes the file again in its own form.
UI_Prepackaged_ServerUntyped: %1 sandbox settings are written as text, because no setting of that name is loaded here (their mod isn't enabled, or a typo): the server reads text into any kind of setting.
UI_Prepackaged_ServerLeftVersion: %1: VERSION is the file's own version, not a group of settings
UI_Prepackaged_ServerLeftGroup: %1: this name is also a group of settings, of the game or the pack
UI_Prepackaged_ServerLeftValue: %1: the name before the dot is a setting of its own, not a group
UI_Prepackaged_LinesCopied: Copied to the clipboard and saved in Zomboid/Lua/%1.
UI_Prepackaged_LinesCopiedOnly: Copied to the clipboard, but Zomboid/Lua/%1 couldn't be saved.
UI_Prepackaged_LinesFailed: The server lines couldn't be made: %1
UI_Prepackaged_LinesSandbox: Add these lines to the end of Zomboid/Server/<server>_SandboxVars.lua, which the server writes when it first starts (%1 settings), then start it again:
UI_Prepackaged_LinesLeftInvalid: Left out, not a value its setting takes: %1
UI_Prepackaged_LinesLeftVersion: Left out, VERSION is the file's own version: %1
UI_Prepackaged_LinesLeftGroup: Left out, the name is also a group of settings: %1
UI_Prepackaged_LinesLeftValue: Left out, the name before the dot is a setting of its own: %1
UI_Prepackaged_HostNoName: Type a name for the server preset.
UI_Prepackaged_HostBadName: "%1" can't be a server name: it can't hold / \ : ; " . or _zombies.
UI_Prepackaged_HostLongName: "%1" is too long for a server name.
UI_Prepackaged_HostFeature: The game has no %1 any more, so Set up a server can't work until Prepackaged is updated.
UI_Prepackaged_HostAsk: Set up the server %1 from %2, version %3:
UI_Prepackaged_HostAskRestore: Put the server %1 back as in backup %2:
UI_Prepackaged_HostFileRewritten: Zomboid/Server/%1: written again by the game, with the same content.
UI_Prepackaged_HostRegionsCreated: Zomboid/Server/%1: created, with the game's default spawn regions.
UI_Prepackaged_HostZombiesRemoved: Zomboid/Server/%1: removed, as the game moves its settings into the _SandboxVars.lua file.
UI_Prepackaged_HostAskPack: The server gets the pack's WorkshopItems and Mods, its Map if it has one, and its %1 sandbox settings. Its other settings stay as they are.
UI_Prepackaged_HostAskBackup: Its %1 server settings and %2 sandbox settings go back to the backup's values.
UI_Prepackaged_HostAskSaved: The preset as it is now is backed up first, and Restore in the Prepackaged window brings it back.
UI_Prepackaged_HostAskReload: Not every mod whose sandbox settings it sets or keeps is loaded, so the game reloads its mods with them, then with your own list again. Your own list stays as it is.
UI_Prepackaged_HostAskUnusable: Can't be used, so their sandbox settings are left out (%1): %2. The game version doesn't fit or a mod they need is missing.
UI_Prepackaged_HostAskMemory: Host gives the server %1 MB of memory, as the pack suggests.
UI_Prepackaged_HostAskGo: Then the Host screen opens with it chosen. Go ahead?
UI_Prepackaged_HostDone: The server %1 is set up: %2 sandbox settings set.
UI_Prepackaged_HostBackup: The preset from before is backup %1 in Restore.
UI_Prepackaged_HostNotSaved: The game couldn't save the server %1 in %2.
UI_Prepackaged_HostNoBackup: The server %1 couldn't be backed up to Zomboid/Lua/%2, so nothing was changed.
UI_Prepackaged_HostFailed: The server %1 couldn't be set up: %2
UI_Prepackaged_FailHostFile: Zomboid/Lua/%1 couldn't be saved, so nothing was changed.
UI_Prepackaged_HostLost: The result of setting up the server couldn't be read from Zomboid/Lua/%1. Check the server on the Host screen.
UI_Prepackaged_HostNoScreen: The game has no %1 any more, so open Host yourself and choose %2.
UI_Prepackaged_Reason_NotLoaded: %1: no mod that is loaded has it
UI_Prepackaged_Reason_NoOption: %1: the mod has no such option
UI_Prepackaged_Reason_Feature: %1: the game has no %2 any more
UI_Prepackaged_Reason_Build: %1: Build %2 of the game can't hold this
UI_Prepackaged_Reason_Type: %1: the pack gives a %2 value, but the option is a %3
UI_Prepackaged_Reason_Count: %1: the pack gives %2 ticks, but the option has %3
UI_Prepackaged_Reason_NotRead: %1: its mod makes it after the game reads ModOptions.ini, so Prepackaged can't see your value
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_BadLine: This line doesn't fit the format of its section and is skipped.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_UnknownSection: Unknown section %1: its lines are skipped.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_OutsideSection: This line comes before any section and is skipped.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_RepeatedKey: %1 is set again; the first value is kept.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_BadId: The id "%1" must be 1 to 48 letters, digits, _ or -.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_BadVersion: The version "%1" must be MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH: three whole numbers with dots between them and no leading zeros, such as 1.0.0.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_WholeVersion: The version "%1" is one number, but a version has three: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, such as %1.0.0.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_BadWorkshopId: "%1" is not a Workshop ID, skipped.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_BadModId: "%1" is not a mod ID, skipped.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_BadNumber: %1 must be a whole number from 1, not "%2".
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_OptionalInMods: %1 is in Mods already, so it isn't optional.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_CollectionCycle: Collection %1 lists %2, which leads back to it.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_BadKeyPart: "%1" is not part of a key bind, skipped.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_BadKey: The key bind %1 has no key, skipped.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_TooManyFields: This line has more than 4 fields, and values can't contain |. Skipped.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_BadSandboxName: "%1" is not a sandbox option name, skipped.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_BadLock: "%1" is not a Page or Page.option entry, skipped.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_NotFirst: Put %1 first in Mods: mods that load before it can make a player's own mod options look like defaults, and their key binds like the game's own.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_TooBig: This file is too big: a pack file can have up to %1 lines and %2 characters.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_LineTooLong: This line is longer than %1 characters.
